capabilities: Import external images from URLs, file://, and base64 data URIs into the vault and rewrite the links
Name and place pasted images using variable templates such as ./assets/${noteFileName}
Convert and compress images per note, folder, or whole vault with confirmation
Rotate, flip, crop, copy, and convert images from context menus
Browse note-level and folder-level image galleries with filtering and sorting
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop-only. GIF, SVG, TIFF, HEIC, and AVIF have layered compatibility where editing and compression may not be stable. Default interface language is Simplified Chinese. Full documentation lives on an external docs site.
problem: Obsidian leaves pasted and remote images with uncontrolled names and locations, with no compression, format conversion, gallery browsing, or undo for image changes.
